trailhead.label: Kühhof car park above Latzfons, the board’s start

cautions: Cows and horses graze on the Kühberg and Latzfons alps in summer: keep your dog on a lead.
Rocky, stony stretches around the Schalderer Scharte.
Open high ground at about 2,100 m: turn back if storms build.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Kühhof car park above Latzfons, the boar: Parcheggio del Kühhof sopra Latzfons, la partenza indicata dalla scheda ufficiale
textIt.Cows and horses graze on the Kühberg and: D'estate mucche e cavalli pascolano sulle malghe del Kühberg e di Latzfons: tieni il cane al guinzaglio.
textIt.Rocky, stony stretches around the Schald: Tratti rocciosi e sassosi intorno alla Schalderer Scharte.
textIt.Open high ground at about 2,100 m: turn: Terreno d'alta quota aperto a circa 2.100 m: torna indietro se si formano temporali.
